value.rationale: The naturally smallest competing pair/triple orders can create the source’s anomalous coexistence/full-cooperation bistability. Exact all-amplitude preservation at one nontrivial mean interaction order and a strict, computable opposite response at every other mean resolve how seasonal composition changes the local cooperation coexistence-loss threshold. No general downstream theorem or empirical intervention is claimed.
